name: Calculate available inventory

import json,subprocess,sys
cases=[{'stock': {}, 'reservations': [], 'now': 10}, {'stock': {'a': 8}, 'reservations': [], 'now': 10}]
expected=[{}, {'a': 8}]
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"main.py",json.dumps(cases)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
assert json.loads(p.stdout)==expected,(p.stdout,expected)
